paragraphs: Kana sells a clinical intelligence platform built for CCBHCs and behavioral health nonprofits, covering the path from intake to care and the tracking of outcomes. The product is described as generating notes, care plans, and outcomes, with the stated aim of cutting administrative work. Kana states that it works with an existing EHR and that integration is included at no extra cost.

A second page describes Kana as an app for people managing their own mental wellbeing, used alone or alongside therapy. Features listed include mood logging, journaling, self-assessments, and secure messaging with a therapist between sessions.

For the nonprofit audience, Kana ties session notes to reporting, saying each note becomes a dashboard ready for grants and Medicaid. Kana describes the platform as HIPAA compliant and audit ready. Setup and training are described as handled by Kana rather than by the customer.

quote.text: Capacity without burnout. Outcomes without extra admin.
